requirement: A write waiting for the site's write lease leaves the site's queue, so the conversation holding the lease keeps writing

oracle.ref: PR #1479 (fix); fix evidence: Review 19/10/2026: a script with the real createCallMemory + waitOutLease showed A's read answered only after B's whole lease wait (up to 100 s); A's lease then lapsed and B wrote mid-request
oracle.invariant: S1: A's write is answered while B is still waiting; B sends again only after A's call. S2: A's read answers before B's wait ends, and B's next send is queued behind it.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

assertionIds: 🔒 C1: on Joomla the conversation holding the lease writes while another waits for it — the waiter is out of the site flight
🔒 C1: the conversation holding the lease is not queued behind the write waiting for it, and the waiter queues again behind it
